summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) of the cipher-box project, including wave-based plan execution, security review, code simplification, and human checkpoint verification of the web client login flow.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed successfully across 3 waves. Two HIGH security issues fixed (key length bounds checks, Debug trait redaction). Code simplified (deduped HKDF derivation, eliminated double ECIES wrap). A critical bug discovered and fixed: fetchAndDecryptMetadata in folder.service.ts and sdk-core didn't handle v2 binary blobs, causing sync failures. Checkpoint approved after confirming migration succeeded silently.

repo: The vault migration ran successfully at 00:12:38 UTC but NestJS doesn't auto-log request routes, making it appear to have never been called

orval codegen generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields — `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround for this pre-existing orval bug, not a code smell
fetchAndDecryptMetadata in both apps/web/src/services/folder.service.ts and packages/sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts blindly JSON.parse'd IPFS blobs without handling v2 binary format
Desktop vault init (commands/vault.rs) was double-wrapping rootFolderKey with ECIES — once for DB storage, once for v2 blob — using the same public key
OTPs from Web3Auth are logged in clear text in the API dev server output

code.finding: Migration IIFE runs non-blocking after PATH B login; deriveVaultIpnsKeypair was called twice with identical inputs — hoisted above try/catch and reused
fetchAndDecryptMetadata used JSON.parse on raw IPFS bytes without detecting v2 binary format — fixed by checking for v2 magic bytes and stripping header before parse
Same v2 blob handling bug as folder.service.ts — same fix applied
serialize_vault_blob_v2 changed from returning Vec<u8> to Result<Vec<u8>, Error> to add key length bounds checking — all callers updated to propagate error
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse had derived Debug impls that would expose encrypted key material in logs — replaced with custom impls that redact sensitive fields

workflow: When an API call appears to never fire, check the database directly — NestJS doesn't auto-log all routes
The GSD security:review command runs as a subagent and produces .planning/security/REVIEW-[timestamp].md with findings categorized by severity
Playwright MCP can be used for browser automation during checkpoint verification to capture console logs
The simplify skill launches three parallel review agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) then aggregates findings

friction: API Error: Unable to connect to API (ConnectionRefused) caused the first security:review invocation to fail entirely, requiring a retry
orval codegen bug with nullable string fields forces `as unknown as string` casts throughout the API client usage — cannot be fixed at the DTO level
NestJS not logging request routes made the migration appear to silently fail, requiring direct database inspection to confirm success
Playwright session was cleared by HMR after fixing folder.service.ts, requiring a full re-login flow to continue verification
gsd-tools init used the wrong working directory initially (cipher-box instead of cipher-box-phase-20), requiring manual directory detection
open_items: M-1: Recovery tool private key not zeroed after use
M-2: No dedup guard on concurrent vault migration from multiple browser tabs
M-3: ECIES re-wrap on every root folder FUSE publish — optimization would cache wrapped key in AppState
L-1: Zero-length key accepted by deserializers
L-2: No SRI hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html
Device registry sync fails with CryptoError: Invalid registry format — pre-existing schema mismatch between current device registry format and IPFS-stored format (tracked in .planning/todos/pending/)
Bin IPNS name 404 resolution failure — pre-existing issue (tracked in .planning/todos/pending/)
